summary: Comprehensive testing of the new Coco Injector feature (frontend + backend). All 9 scenarios from the review request passed. Backend gating (unauth 401, invalid duration 400) works, admin usage map exposes injector key and premium user's injector count incremented (1 -> 2) after one successful UI injection. Frontend: /injector renders with correct testids, no h1 heading in main, top nav shows Coco Injector link, tabs/search/tile filtering work (GBP shows only GBP pairs, nonsense shows 'No markets match'), OTC tiles carry '(OTC)' suffix while Real tiles do not, market -> duration -> inject flow works, analyzing lines cycle (including 'Sampling 5-minute structure...'), result card shows correct direction/entry/duration/expiry (entry rule verified: click 01:45:05 -> entry 01:46, expiry 01:51 for 5 min), reset returns to market step. Free-tier lock: standard user demoted to free saw the upgrade-gate modal (Unlock the full experience) and no analyzing stage started. User restored to standard. Mobile (390x844): no horizontal overflow, duration cards fit in one row at y=216, bottom-nav-injector present (href=/injector) replacing Future, and 'More' sheet lists Future Signals. Design check: computed border-color of .inj-btn (rgba(139,92,255,.55)), .inj-btn-ghost (rgba(190,150,255,.46)), .inj-dur (rgba(168,128,255,.2)), .inj-panel (rgba(168,128,255,.2)) are violet-tinted (NOT white/grey). Dashboard shows Coco Injector in quota + tools grid.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: '.inj-tile' selector was NOT_FOUND when checking computed styles (tiles are likely rendered with a different class). Not a functional issue — tiles work and appear violet-tinted visually — but if the design spec explicitly requires the class .inj-tile, main agent may want to reconcile the class name. All other listed classes (.inj-btn, .inj-btn-ghost, .inj-dur, .inj-panel) resolve correctly with non-white borders.
POST /api/signals/injector validates duration before authentication (invalid duration returns 400 even without auth cookie). Order matches spec but conventionally auth is checked first; low priority.

Admin API cookie jar workflow: POST /api/admin/login {username,password,secretKey='iamhear'} -> save cookie; GET /api/admin/users returns usageToday.injector.
